---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short description of what you want and why.

## Controller and firmware

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Controller model | e.g. `SMO S40`, `VVM S320` |
| Firmware version | e.g. `4.12.6` |

## Is this about a specific data point or register?

If you want a specific firmware register exposed as a HA entity, include:
- The register name as it appears on the controller display or in the Entity Manager card
- The point ID (variableId) if you know it — visible in the Entity Manager card metadata panel
- What entity type it should be (sensor, switch, number, select, binary_sensor)

## Describe the feature

What should the bridge do? How would it work from the user's perspective?

## Why is this useful?

What problem does it solve or what does it enable in Home Assistant?

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried working around this with an existing feature? What didn't work?

## Additional context

Screenshots, HA automation examples, links to relevant Nibe documentation.
